Task success rate.definition: Successful trials divided by total trials

Prediction error.unit: SI per quantity (m, rad) / steps [PROPOSED; OWNER DECISION]

Collision rate.definition: Trials with collisions divided by total trials

Path length.definition: Sum of distances along the executed trajectory

Execution time.definition: Recorded simulation or wall-clock duration, clearly identified

Planning latency.definition: Time required to generate and evaluate candidates

Risk rejection rate.definition: Rejected candidates divided by evaluated candidates

Reliability.definition: Successful runs and documented failure categories

evidence_sources.Task success rate: eval/metrics.py success aggregation and Wilson interval

evidence_sources.Planning latency: decision sidecar phase timings; full-system latency remains UNVERIFIED
evidence_sources.Reliability: failure_states and evaluation_failure_category in frozen summaries
